summary: Project purpose into bounded next-process token stream

delivery.outcome: Project an accepted existential-purpose DSL and current ecosystem evidence into a deterministic, hash-chained stream of read-only next-process tokens that can be handed to the existing Control authority and URI-binding pipeline.
nonGoals: Do not let Twin schedule, execute, approve or merge mutations
Do not interpret raw natural language without the require-LLM boundary
Do not generate executable connector URIs outside the registered binder
Do not treat an emitted token as an execution or completion receipt
Do not create a busy loop when ecosystem context is unchanged

architecture.decision: Keep purpose-conditioned next-process prediction in the read-only Twin. Consume only an accepted typed purpose, select from deterministic next actions, emit a non-executable projection URI and leave exact runtime URI binding, grants, execution, EQL and rollback to Control and its agents.
interfaceChanges: twin-subactor evolve emits a purpose-bound next-process token on context changes
twin-subactor.organism-purpose/v1 and twin-subactor.process-token/v1 become public read-only contracts
dataChanges: Purpose text, snapshots and process decisions are represented only by bounded fields and content digests; no secrets are accepted
architecture.rollback: Remove the evolve projection and its contracts; no runtime or external state is mutated by the feature

commands: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m twin_subactor.cli --offline evolve --purpose docs/examples/subactor-purpose.v1.json --once
